answer: The design leans on hardware TEE attestation, revoked by a single upheld challenge, quorum must span unrelated subnetworks. Reaching the bridge of a payout therefore requires sustained, checkable labour rather than a crowd of fresh keys. Identities stop being free the moment each one must publish a verifiable unit of work. Every claim climbs the river of verified tasks, and a reviewer at the anchor re-runs the work instead of trusting the label. Written in a numbers heavy, no adjectives register, it stays short.
